study_meta.period_raw: January 21 to February 26, 2020 (Tianjin: Jan 21–Feb 22, 2020; Singapore: Jan 23–Feb 26, 2020)
study_meta.population_raw: COVID-19 cases in two contact-traced clusters: Singapore (93 confirmed cases) and Tianjin (135 confirmed cases)
study_meta.sample_size_raw: 93 cases (Singapore), 135 cases (Tianjin); serial interval analysis uses first 4 cases per cluster for ICC method
study_meta.method_raw: Contact tracing data from publicly available sources; ICC (index case to case) mixture model method (Vink et al., 2014) for serial interval accounting for unknown intermediates; interval censoring for incubation period; gamma distribution assumed; bootstrapping for CIs
